title: Red apple
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='appleBright' cx='38%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8a8a'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#e8384f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a80030'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='appleLight' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3b3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff7a7a' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- apple body: two lobes joined in the middle -->
  <path d='M50 30 C36 22, 16 26, 14 48 C12 68, 28 84, 42 86 C46 86.6, 48 84, 50 84 C52 84, 54 86.6, 58 86 C72 84, 88 68, 86 48 C84 26, 64 22, 50 30 Z' fill='url(#appleBright)'/>

  <!-- shaded edge on lower right, lighter red for contrast -->
  <path d='M50 84 C54 86.6, 58 86, 64 84 C78 78, 88 64, 86 48 C85 38, 80 31, 73 27 C80 33, 84 40, 84 50 C84 66, 74 78, 62 82 C57 83.5, 53 84, 50 84 Z' fill='#ff6b6b' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='32' cy='42' rx='11' ry='8' fill='url(#appleLight)' transform='rotate(-25 32 42)'/>

  <!-- dimple at top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='32' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#c00030'/>

  <!-- stem -->
  <path d='M50 31 C49 24, 51 18, 55 13' stroke='#8a5a2b' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 31 C49 24, 51 18, 55 13' stroke='#b07a3f' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M54 16 C62 10, 74 10, 78 14 C74 22, 62 24, 54 16 Z' fill='#3fbf5f'/>
  <path d='M57 16 C63 14, 71 13, 76 14 C70 19, 63 20, 57 16 Z' fill='#7de89a' opacity='0.8'/>
  <path d='M55 16 C64 14, 73 12, 77 14' stroke='#2a8a44' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none'/>
</svg>
